title: Count only tool calls that can write as overlapping an open Engram test check
outcome: From tm-winf round-10 review (Claude, Note). Every tool start through command_started counts as a fresh command that marks open checks overlapped, including Codex webSearch and ACP tool calls identified only by a title (reads and searches in Gemini/Cursor). A read-only call during a running test makes the check Unknown: safe (never overclaims) but it lowers evidence yield, most for ACP runtimes. Consider counting only calls whose kind can write (ACP kind execute/edit/delete/move) or that carry a command line; keep unknown kinds conservative.
